title: Keep nested field overrides isolated from shared query data
answers: Why do all series in a Dashboard datasource panel inherit the table column's display name?
How can Time series to table leak units, colors or thresholds into another panel?
How should applyFieldOverrides merge config into nested frames without mutating source data?
body:
Symptom: A panel using the -- Dashboard -- datasource with withTransforms: false inherits a source table's column display name and styling after Time series to table.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides merges parent config with defaultsDeep, which mutates its first argument; nested fields can share config objects with source query fields.
Fix pattern: Copy each nested frame and its fields, deep-clone each field's config before merging parent defaults, and apply recursive overrides to the copied frames. Returned nested fields must still receive the parent config.
Constraints: This pattern applies to config merging for FieldType.frame values that may share source data. Shallow config copies are insufficient because defaultsDeep can mutate shared custom or thresholds objects; the required isolation concerns config, not a deep copy of all frame data.
applies: Changes to nested-frame config propagation in applyFieldOverrides, including frames produced by Time series to table.
